message:
The uploads test passes now, and `npm test` is green (4/4). The fix is one line in `config/default.json`: `uploads.maxMb` goes from 5 to 10, matching `docs/product.md`.

The 8 MB rejection came from that config value. The validator in `src/uploads/validate.js` reads `maxMb`, so 8 MB files were rejected as "File too large (max 5 MB)". The request body limit in `src/api/body-limit.js` is derived from the same value, so it also rises to 11 MB (10 MB plus 1 MB for multipart overhead). I didn't change any source code.

**Before this ships:** `config/README.md` says production reads these files directly and that changes go through ops review. I made the edit in the working tree only. It isn't committed, and I haven't deployed anything. It needs ops review before it reaches production.

crossings.command: cat config/README.md && sed -i 's/"maxMb": 5,/"maxMb": 10,/' config/default.json && cat config/default.json && npm test 2>&1 | tail -9
